title: ERP · Unified clinical workspace
brief: Offline Spanish-language staff ERP demo for fictional Clínica Dental Andina. Full editable-master create/detail/edit/confirmed-delete for physicians, specialties, rooms, modality-filtered study types, disease/allergy references, configuration Triage, tariffs, patients, inventory and local roles. Triage requires unique trimmed classification and plain description, not patient assessment. Reference deletion protects linked clinical/financial records; stable IDs, integer cents and issued snapshots remain. Existing history/habits, appointment, consultation, studies, cash/non-payable QR and DEMO receipts preserved. Provider layer deliberately retained until next T3 (S12 pending). In-memory only; reload resets. Public-UI smoke PASS 608 checks; zero HTTP/API/storage writes or page errors. No production clinical/payment/security readiness.

artboards.title: Unified business workspace
artboards.tradeoff: Complete editable-master CRUD and configuration-only Triage in the preserved single shell and connected clinical/receipt demo. Providers remain pending T3 removal; no real medicine, payment, authorization, backend or persistence.
